The '''father''' of [[Andronikos Revel]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Andronikos Revel]] and used to run a small shop on a backwater planet. He once shot his then-six year old son in the foot for crying.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andronikos Revel's father is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Andronikos Revel companion mission.
